params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If specified, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or a field.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

overloads.semanticRole: Associates (or, for the current process, replaces) the placeholder text shown when the object(s) designated by object and * are empty.

constraints: Replaces, for the current process, any placeholder text already set via the Property List.
Only applies to variable, field, or combo-box form objects; supports Alpha/Text data, and Date/Time data only if the object has the 'Blank if null' property.
Does not support inserting xliff references (unlike placeholder text set via the Property List).
